name: ShapeNet Part
description: A part-annotated subset of ShapeNetCore containing 16,881 3D models across 16 object categories, with point-level part segmentation annotations.
citation: Yi, L., Kim, V. G., Ceylan, D., et al. (2016). A Scalable Active Framework for Region Annotation in 3D Shape Collections. ACM Transactions on Graphics, 35(6), Article 210. https://doi.org/10.1145/2980179.2980238
